adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 rework recovered the Table 2 MIC matrix, Table 3 intracellular CFU rows, supplementary Tables S4/S6, and linked database reconciliation; remaining issues are caution-level conflicts, not open rework blockers.

materials_exhausted.note: Best-effort local source recovery covered XML/PDF/OA package/supplementary PDF text and linked database rows relevant to the worker-2/4/6 blockers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Primary Table 1 identity and Table 2 MIC values were checked against linked database rows; true source_conflict and modified-residue notation cautions are preserved.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered source-supported MIC, MIC50, intracellular CFU, pure-culture reduction, and C. elegans infection-model rows from XML Table 2/3 plus supplementary Tables S4/S6.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 limited mechanism claims to rpoA expression suppression, negative membrane-permeabilization evidence, and host mitobiogenesis safety context with direct assay locators.

caution_findings.evidence_context: CAMP/dbAMP (RFR)4XB activity text conflicts with primary Table 2 for selected isolates; primary Table 2 values are retained and the database rows remain source_conflict.
DBAASP RXR/RFR sequence rows use terminal X where primary Table 1 uses terminal B; modified-residue notation is preserved rather than normalized.
Supplement Tables S4/S6 were recovered from PDF text, not spreadsheet tables; values were manually checked against local supplementary text.
Mechanism claims are limited to text/caption-supported results and direct assay classes; figure-only exact curves were not digitized or invented.
